description: This file defines the LineReporter class, a custom test reporter for Playwright that outputs test progress and results to the terminal, handling stdout, stderr, test steps, pauses, errors, and test end summaries.

classes.name: LineReporter
classes.description: A terminal-based test reporter for Playwright that displays real-time test progress, errors, and summaries.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test suite, outputs starting message.

methods.name: onStdOut
methods.description: Handles standard output from tests, dumps to stdout.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Handles standard error from tests, dumps to stderr.

methods.name: _dumpToStdio
methods.description: Helper to write test output chunks to the appropriate stream, with formatting.

methods.name: onTestBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test, updates progress line.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test step, updates progress line if TTY.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test step, updates progress line if TTY.

methods.name: onTestPaused
methods.description: Handles pausing of a test, displays pause message and errors if any.

methods.name: onTestEnd
methods.description: Handles test completion, displays failure info if applicable.

methods.name: _updateLine
methods.description: Updates the current progress line with test info.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during testing, outputs error message.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Handles end of test suite, outputs summary.
